title: Data-driven linear analysis of dynamical systems via nonlinearity-subtracted dynamic mode decomposition
summary: The Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) has been consolidated as a basic tool for data-driven analysis of dynamical systems, allowing simultaneous identification of coherent structures and their dynamics from time-resolved measurements. However, with a linear regression at its core, DMD is unable to produce accurate models from recordings of dynamics that are inherently nonlinear, such as the response to large perturbations and the evolution on chaotic attractors.
